## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The opening front-matter (*juànshǒu* 卷首) volume of [智祥](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E7%A5%A5) Zhìxiáng's three-part *Fǎhuá jīng shòushǒu* 法華經授手 commentarial complex: this work ([KR6d0087](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0087), the front matter), the *Shòushǒu kē* ([KR6d0088](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0088), the sectional analysis), and the *Shòushǒu* proper ([KR6d0089](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0089), the ten-juan main commentary). Compiled by Pínjí Zhìxiáng 頻吉智祥 (1637–1709), the early-Qīng Línjì Chán master.

**Abstract**

The *Shòushǒu* 授手 (literally "hand-bestowal" or "passing-by-hand") title is drawn from the classical Chinese tutorial metaphor of the master directly transmitting knowledge from hand to hand to the student, and indicates a commentary intended for direct face-to-face pedagogical use. The three-part *Shòushǒu* complex — front matter, sectional analysis, and main commentary — is parallel to the *Dàchéng* complex ([KR6d0084](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0084), [KR6d0085](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0085), [KR6d0086](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0086)) in providing complete navigational and substantive apparatus for systematic Lotus Sūtra study.

The composition is bracketed within Zhìxiáng's productive period c. 1670–1709, with the *Shòushǒu* complex most plausibly placed in his mature productive years.
